text:
Maya R: Heads-up — we're kicking off SA-west1 cluster bring-up tomorrow and need a fast path for GPU capacity so staging can validate end-to-end. Short ask below, can @Arjun K take the lead on quota requests?
Arjun K: On it. Can you confirm target instance type + target vCPU/GPU counts and the window we'll need reserved?
Maya R: Primary target = 24 x A100 80GB (or 48 x A10G if A100 unavailable). Need reservation for 48 hours starting 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC for soak tests. Also want a softer fallback of 72 x T4 for low-cost validation.
Li W: For soak we need at least 12 nodes with 2 x A100 each to test multi-GPU KV-cache scaling. App-side: runtime needs to exercise continuous batching at 2k tokens/s.
Sam J: @Maya R are we planning dedicated reserved capacity or a temporary committed use discount? Cost ops needs estimate.
Maya R: Temporary reservation (provider-side hold) + short RU commitment if discount needed. Rough cost estimate: A100 path ~ $9k/day; T4 fallback ~ $1.6k/day. Budget approved up to $20k for the bring-up window.
Arjun K: Opening cloud quota request now. Drafting support case text: 
```
Project: redwood-prod-staging
Region: southamerica-west1
Quota: 24 A100 80GB GPUs (or 48 A10G) for 48h starting 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC.
Fallback: 72 T4 GPUs for 72h.
Reason: cluster bring-up + performance soak + KV cache validation before vendor acceptance.
Contact: arjun@redwood.ai, ops oncall.
```
Arjun K: Also submitting a capacity reservation (if provider supports) and requesting expedited review. Anyone from runtime team want to add validation checklist to the ticket?
Li W: Add: run these tests during reservation window — 1) continuous-batching latency at 8k tokens/second aggregate, 2) KV cache hit-rate > 65% on synthetic workload, 3) canaries for model fallback path (A100->A10G quantized) without >5% error rate.
Maya R: Good. Ops-bot: please create internal intake doc and link the cloud support case when created.
ops-bot: Created intake https://redwood.internal/ops/intake/BRG-2026-072 and set status = waiting-on-cloud. Case placeholder ID assigned: CS-00098765.
cloud-support: Case CS-00098765 received — expediting quota review. Asking for usage history and architecture diagram. Please attach cluster topology + expected sustained vCPU/GPU hours.
Sam J: I attached cost breakdown and topology diagrams to the intake doc. Also adding a short rollback plan — if quota not granted by 2026-04-01 18:00 UTC, we'll run a staged bring-up in eu-south1 with borrowed capacity and reduce soak window to 24h.
Maya R: Perfect. Final ask for Arjun: include fallback mapping (A100->A10G->T4) and pre-approved model quantization profiles so we can flip routing quickly. If cloud-support approves reservation, schedule an internal handoff meeting at 2026-04-02 07:00 UTC.
Arjun K: Will do. I'll post the support case link and reservation confirmation here once we have them. 
Li W: Also pinging runtime on-call to be available during the soak.
Maya R: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for questions. :thumbsup:
